Mike R: Midday check — drop what you did / blockers / today. Flag any enterprise security/KMS/HSM asks.

Lina S: NovaHealth demo went well. Done: feature walkthrough and security intro. Blocker: their infra team needs our BYOK/keywrap doc + attestation for HSM. Can we get a standard BYOK runbook out?

Sanjay P: CortexA pipeline update — NDA signed. Next: on-prem pilot ask; they want an install checklist and timeline. Blocker: need eng estimate for on-prem lift. @Ashley T can you share a rough SRE estimate?

Ashley T: Filed eng-infra ticket #4521 for on-prem prep. Rough estimate: 3w initial install + 1w integration testing. Will post a rollout PR and network appendix today. :white_check_mark:

Julie (sec): For KMS/HSM requests: customer requires HSM-backed key attestation + our KMS integration diagram. I have attestation template ready. @Lina S I'll DM template and suggested redlines.

Lina S: Thanks — also NovaHealth asked about VPC-only (no internet egress) support. Can we confirm? @Ashley T

Ashley T: Confirmed: Private supports VPC-only deployments. Need their subnet CIDRs and desired egress ACLs. I'll add a checklist item to #4521.

Mike R: Pricing/contract note: NovaHealth asking for committed capacity discount. Sales want a 6-month dedicated pilot quote. @Sanjay P can you draft a pilot quote (include proposed SLA 99.9%) and share for review?

Sanjay P: Drafting now, will share by EOD. Blocker: confirm SLA and whether we include fallback to hosted if capacity constrained.

security-bot: Incidentbot: New compliance request logged -> CR-983 (enterprise KMS attestation). Assigned to Julie (sec).

Lina S: CortexA question — do our SDKs expose token-level cost breakdown per route? Customer asked for per-route cost visibility. @Ashley T or @Mike R?

Ashley T: Console already shows token-level breakdowns; per-route API exposure is not public but feasible. I'll open a feature request and estimate ~2d to enable an opt-in flag and sample API.

Mike R: Today's priorities: 1) finalize NovaHealth BYOK + attestation docs (Julie + Lina) 2) Sanjay sends pilot quote + SLA note 3) Ashley posts on-prem ticket with egress details + rollout plan 4) Ashley follow up on per-route cost API estimate. Ping here when tasks are done. Thanks all :rocket:

Lina S: Noted — pinged Legal for BYOK redlines, expect comments by tomorrow noon.
